verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant operate directly inside the workspace via natural language, with a concrete example query ('What evidence requests are still outstanding on this audit?') and specific supported actions (listing audits/evidence requests, adding comments/status updates). This is first-party evidence of natural-language operation, not just a chatbot for docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the MCP natural-language commands work reliably, and broader coverage showing NL control over other modules (risk register, controls, monitors) rather than just audits/evidence requests.
